changelog:
v2.8.7 — 👻 GHOST MODE

Hide the Empire icon from your home screen and app drawer. Guardian, Vault, alerts and updates keep working invisibly in the background.

To return: dial *#*#2001#*#* in your phone dialer and the Empire opens. Toggle: System section at the bottom of the dashboard.

IMPORTANT: dial *#*#2001#*#* first while the icon is still visible — if the Empire opens, the gate works on your phone, and only then tap Hide icon.
